name: notify-telegram
description: Outcome notifications to one Telegram chat per project through the Bot API (.claude/scripts/notify)

detect.ask: Send workflow notifications (ship, post-op, verify and similar outcomes) to a Telegram chat for this project?

facts.name: NOTIFY_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
facts.meaning: The Telegram chat this project posts to; a record only, the script reads TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
facts.ask: Which Telegram chat ID should this project post to? (Answer none to record it later with an upgrade.)

owner_tasks.task: Create this project's Telegram bot and channel, then set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: follow docs/agent/notify-telegram.md, Set it up
owner_tasks.why: until both are set, .claude/scripts/notify prints 'not configured' and sends nothing

env.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
env.purpose: Bot API token of this project's notification bot
env.how_to_get: Message @BotFather, send /newbot, copy the token. Set it in the shell environment or the gitignored .claude/notify.env (docs/agent/notify-telegram.md)

env.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
env.purpose: Chat (channel or group) the bot posts to
env.how_to_get: Add the bot to this project's channel or group, post a message, read chat.id from the Bot API getUpdates call (docs/agent/notify-telegram.md)
